evidence_gaps: Executed guarantee and bank collateral/fee/recovery terms
Final grid regulation and project approval
Customer liquidity budget and calibrated call-risk estimate
limitations: All bank offers, duration, risk and opportunity spread are synthetic; guarantee face is an announced estimate, not a funded expense
Simple undiscounted nominal NIS over the stated horizon; all fees paid upfront, no tax, FX or compounding
Opportunity spread is net of collateral interest; do not add another funding cost on top
Equal face liability and call risk across offers; collateral can fund a call but does not reduce the legal liability
Full call occurs before recovery; expected loss is a separate probability-weighted measure, not a liquidity reserve
Initial budget feasibility does not establish full-call solvency, bank approval, covenant headroom or project value
No lease, land purchase, construction revenue, grid eligibility or physical dispatch model
